title: A tracked part at zero still hides In Stock; the by-line API keeps an untracked part in_stock
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-U1 is untracked with no bins (nothing on hand). A tracked part with nothing on hand: if it does not exist, create "QAPL-Z0" at Staging Heavy Duty (New Inventory Part, tracking on, the default bin with quantity 0). An open work order at Staging Heavy Duty. DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. On a work order line, Add Part QAPL-U1, Qty 1, and save it.
  2. On the same line, Add Part QAPL-Z0, Qty 1, and save it.
  3. Open the work order's Parts tab.
  4. Reload the work order; in Network open the list-requests-by-line response.
custom_expected:
1. QAPL-U1 is added; its chip on the line reads "In Stock" although nothing is on hand.
  2. QAPL-Z0 is added; the line shows no "In Stock" chip for it.
  3. QAPL-U1 shows "In Stock"; QAPL-Z0 does not.
  4. The QAPL-U1 request reads in_stock with is_tracked false; the QAPL-Z0 request has is_tracked true and is not in_stock.
